title: Eclipse Core
description: Controls eclipse and lunar events, syncing difficulty, weather, and progression for hardcore servers.
body:
Eclipse Core 1.0.0

- Automatic scheduled Blood Moon events (Enhanced Celestials)
- Triggers at fixed real-time times during a session
- Clears weather before triggering when needed
- Increases difficulty during Blood Moon and restores it at dawn
- Server-side only (works in singleplayer too)
